decisions.decision: Town Manager Heather Lemieux will pursue the question of liability (for tree abutters or the Town if trees are not removed) with Town Counsel.
decisions.quote: ms. lemieux will pursue the question of liability with town counsel.

decisions.decision: Unitil agreed to provide data on when roads were pruned and the outages that followed, using its map of outage and pruning locations and dates.
decisions.quote: ms. sankowich stated she could, they have a map with all the location/dates of the outages and the pruning done.

budget_items.topic: Cost-effectiveness of Unitil's tree work versus routine pruning
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Jeffreys said Unitil's current approach would be more cost effective for Unitil than routine pruning, and he opposed it; no dollar figures were given.
budget_items.quote: he suggested it would be more cost effective for unitil to do business this way than to do routine pruning
